doc.title: Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 23, 2003 [interview 2 of 2]

title: Upcoming plans: Germany, Japan, pops concerts
summary: Trips to Germany and Japan with Scott Hamilton and Harry Allen, and pops dates with Skitch Henderson and in Syracuse.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Yeah, right. That’s a good one. What’s coming up in the near future?

Well I’m going in I think September I’m going to Germany for a couple of weeks. I’ll come back for a while and then I’m going to Japan with Scott Hamilton and Harry Allen. They are fierce. Two great tenor players.

I mean it. That was one of the most thrilling records I ever made with those guys. And then I’ve got some — I do some pop dates once in a while with Skitch Henderson. I do some with Palm Beach Pops. I’m going to do something in Syracuse this summer. © Fillius Jazz Archive -18-
Right. With the symphony, that’s right.
I’m looking forward to that, yeah.
And then you’re coming back here don’t forget.
Oh yeah I’ll be here. I’m here. I know how to get here now.
